overview.line1: This control plane tracks tested agents from discovery through registry activation.
overview.line2: Review blockers, evidence readiness, and publication state before choosing the next action.

candidates.line1: These candidates are moving through the governed promotion lifecycle.
candidates.line2: Open a candidate to inspect evidence, blockers, approvals, and registry state.

candidate.line1: This record explains why the candidate surfaced and whether its evidence is complete.
candidate.line2: Review every failed gate before recording a promotion lifecycle decision.

blocker.line1: This candidate cannot advance because a required gate failed.
blocker.line2: Review the evidence, then rerun the gate after correcting the issue.

promotionRationale.line1: This decision records why the tested candidate may enter the registry.
promotionRationale.line2: Confirm the evidence snapshot and rationale before queuing irreversible publication.

registryPending.line1: The reviewer approved promotion, and the worker has not activated the registry version.
registryPending.line2: Monitor publication; production selection will not change until the worker succeeds.

registryFailure.line1: Registry activation failed, so the candidate remains eligible but blocked.
registryFailure.line2: Review the failure, then retry after correcting the registry connection.

evaluations.line1: These runs collect measurements for the active evaluation plans.
evaluations.line2: Inspect incomplete or failed work before trusting a readiness percentage.

contract.line1: This contract defines the gates, evidence, samples, and weighted score required.
contract.line2: Compare the immutable policy hash before using any readiness decision.

automation.line1: This screen shows work triggered by commands or external schedulers.
automation.line2: Check each owner and last run; disconnected jobs will not run automatically.

registry.line1: This registry lists immutable agent versions activated by successful worker publication.
registry.line2: Confirm the policy hash before selecting a version for production runs.

audit.line1: This timeline replays append-only control-plane events in durable sequence order.
audit.line2: Trace correlation and causation before explaining any lifecycle change.

promote.label: Queue registry publication
promote.consequence: Queues registry publication. Production selection may change only after worker success.
promote.undo: Close this dialog to cancel. You cannot revoke queued publication here.

retryRegistry.label: Retry registry publication
retryRegistry.consequence: Queues another registry attempt with the same stable publication token.
retryRegistry.undo: Close this dialog to cancel. The recorded failure remains available for review.

runEvaluation.label: Queue evaluation
runEvaluation.consequence: Queues a new run against the current immutable evaluation plan.
runEvaluation.undo: Cancel before work starts. Completed results remain append-only evidence.

runCycle.label: Run autonomous cycle
runCycle.consequence: Dispatches the six demo jobs and records their real run history.
runCycle.undo: The cycle is idempotent. Recorded events remain append-only.

runtime.lifecycleDecisionQueued: Recorded the lifecycle decision. Queued registry publication.
runtime.lifecycleDecisionUnavailable: No decision transport exists. The system left the candidate unchanged.
runtime.registryRetryQueued: Queued registry publication with the stable publication token.
runtime.demoCycleDispatched: Dispatched the demo cycle. Durable job runs will appear through the event stream.

body.authorityNotice: Promotion changes which tested version new production runs select. It does not authorize a run or grant tool access.
